title: enhance oncall playbook scoring and runbook suggester
author: Nina Zhao
release_notes: Introduce runbook suggester and playbook scoring engine for on-call workflows; safe default policy and feature flag; metrics and tracing added; no config migration required; rolls out to beta by default.
description:
Motivation: on-call triage is noisy: runbooks drift, noisy pages lack clear playbooks, and on-call juniors often pick inappropriate remediation steps. This PR adds a lightweight scoring engine that ranks runbooks by a compound signal (recent pager frequency, SLO breach correlation, MTTA/MTTR history, and operator feedback) and a runbook suggester that surfaces candidate playbooks in Slack when an alert is paged. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-action and provide actionable, readable playbooks in the incident channel.

What this PR does (single string): - Add playbook scorer module (incident_bot.runbooks.scorer) implementing a weighted scoring model and small calibration table; weights are configurable via feature flags and defaults tuned on last-90-days incidents. - Add runbook suggester integration for Slack async actions: suggests 2–3 candidate runbooks with confidence score; supports 'apply' to populate incident template. - Add CLI tool incident-bot oncall-check to detect rotation conflicts and missing overrides; returns machine-readable JSON for infra pipelines. - Add SLO toolkit helpers used by scorer: burn-rate heuristics and incident-to-SLO attribution helpers. - Wire metrics (incident.runbook_suggestions, incident.playbook_score.{bucket}) and tracing spans for end-to-end latency. - Tests: unit tests for scorer, integration tests for Slack suggestion flow, e2e harness against test SLO store. - Docs: README and playbook guidance doc plus runbook-quality examples.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added and green - [x] Integration tests for Slack flow - [x] E2E harness run locally - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout implemented - [x] Docs updated with usage and tuning guidance

Backward compatibility and rollout: default policy is conservative (low-sensitivity) and disabled in orgs without SLO metadata. Feature gate: ff.runbook_suggester.v2. Rollout plan: beta -> opt-in on 2 pilot teams -> org-wide after 2 weeks and monitoring checks.

Monitoring and safety: suggestion acceptance rate, false-suggestion rate (manual rejection), and MTTA delta are instrumented. We added auto-fallback to a safe template when confidence < 0.15.

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps scoring simple (linear weights) to make tuning auditable; follow-ups will add a lightweight ML ranker in the slo-toolkit repo once we have stable labels.
commits: 4 commits: 1) add runbook scorer core and tests; 2) slack suggester integration and action handler; 3) oncall-check CLI and JSON output; 4) docs and metrics wiring. Short SHAs: a1f3b9c, b2e7d44, c9d1fe2, d4b8a11.

review_thread: Aisha Patel: Please add more context on how the weight defaults were derived. Nina Zhao: We derived weights from a simple grid search over the last 90 days and validated on 3 pilot services; added a note in docs/runbook-suggester.md with calibration results. Luca Moreno: Can suggester handle channels that have suppressed bot messages? Nina Zhao: Yes, we fallback to a direct-thread DM to the on-call and record an event. Priya Singh: Add a toggle to disable suggestions for orgs without SLO metadata? Nina Zhao: Done, ff.runbook_suggester.v2 gates the whole flow and we explicitly check for SLO tags. Daniel Park (SRE): I saw flakiness in the integration test on CI the first run. Nina Zhao: CI retry fixed it; added tighter timeouts and mock for Slack API. Aisha: Approved after docs update. Luca: Approved. Priya: Requested minor change to CLI exit codes; addressed. Daniel: Approved and marked for merge once CI passes.
ci_details: CI: initial run failed due to flaky Slack integration test (timeout). Rerun with mocked responses and added timeouts; subsequent runs passed. Summary: unit tests 128 passed, 2 skipped; integration tests 24 passed; e2e harness simulated 10 incidents. Lint: minor style fixes applied. Coverage: scorer module coverage 92%.
metrics_and_telemetry: New metrics: incident.runbook_suggestions.count (tags: team, alert_type), incident.runbook_suggestions.accept_rate, incident.playbook_score.bucket (0-0.1,0.1-0.3,0.3-0.6,0.6-1.0), incident.suggester.latency_ms; Tracing spans: runbook.scorer.score, runbook.suggester.dispatch. Dashboards: added a new panel in Oncall Overview -> Runbook Suggestions.
merge_outcome: merged via squash and merge on 2026-03-02. Merge commit message: 'oncall: runbook suggester and playbook scorer (v2) - Nina Zhao'. Deployed to staging immediately; feature flag off in production until pilot rollout completes.
notes_for_ops: Operator steps to roll out: 1) Enable ff.runbook_suggester.v2 for pilot team in feature flag dashboard. 2) Monitor incident.runbook_suggestions.accept_rate and MTTA delta. 3) If accept_rate < 0.25 after 48h, revert flag and open ENG-XXXX for tuning. 4) Rotation conflicts flagged by cli/oncall_check.py should be resolved before enabling suggester for that team.
